review.assessment: The diff creates a new solution.py that defines parse_csv_line using a naive line.split(",") approach. It completely omits the required logic for parsing double-quoted fields, handling commas inside quotes, and interpreting doubled double-quotes as literal characters. As written, it only covers trivial unquoted CSV lines and fails the stated scope entirely.

findings.defect: Naive comma splitting breaks quoted fields that contain embedded commas.
Fails to recognize escaped double-quotes ('""') inside fields, leaving the quotes intact instead of unescaping them.
